items.title: Subtitle Placement
items.summary: This small change will result in more reliable and readable subtitles, enhancing the wearer's ability to follow conversations without distraction. It will also reinforce trust by consistently displaying clear information when needed, thus improving overall usability and acceptance.
items.probe: Define one fixed subtitle position rule for V1: keep subtitles at the bottom center of the display.

choices.label: More Prominent
choices.description: Bias toward easier visibility over subtlety.

items.title: Confidence Display
items.summary: This change will provide the wearer with clear and concise indicators of the confidence behind the information being presented. It helps in building trust by showing that the system is aware of its limitations, thus making the assistive behavior more reliable and less intrusive.
items.probe: Choose one confidence display format for V1: label only or label plus short reason.

choices.label: Label Only
choices.description: Keep certainty display minimal and fast to parse.

choices.label: Label + Reason
choices.description: Expose a short reason to improve trust.

items.title: Memory/Cache Policy
items.summary: This change will help maintain fast lookup times while reducing storage overhead and privacy risks. It ensures that the system remains lightweight and discrete, enhancing user trust by avoiding unnecessary memory retention.
items.probe: Define a local cache size limit for new-person memory objects to 100 entries or 1MB of data.

choices.label: Smaller Cache
choices.description: Bias toward tighter local memory and lower load.

choices.label: Recency First
choices.description: Bias toward recent names and conversations.

items.title: Phone/Cloud Boundary
items.summary: This will allow V1 to focus on delivering clear, real-time subtitles without compromising battery life or thermal constraints. It also ensures that memory-intensive tasks do not interfere with core functionality.

choices.description: Keep critical work local unless clearly necessary.
